settings.readOnly: Only workspace owners and admins can change these settings. You can still upload posts below.
settings.requireApprovalHint: Contributors submit posts for review instead of scheduling them directly.
settings.savedReleased: {count, plural, =1 {Saved. One post was waiting for review and is publishing now.} other {Saved. # posts were waiting for review and are publishing now.}}
settings.shortenHint: Replaces links with short ones you control, so clicks can be counted.
settings.subtitle: Workspace, publishing queue and bulk scheduling.
settings.timezoneHint: Every scheduled time you enter is interpreted in this timezone, and stays correct across daylight saving changes.
settings.title: Settings
settings.utmHint: Appended to links in your posts so you can attribute traffic. Leave blank to post links untouched.

setup.title: Set up MS Social Pilot
setup.subtitle: What stands between this server and a scheduled post, and what the installation itself can and cannot do. This page keeps track of both.
setup.subtitleComplete: Everything is in place. This page stays here in case a connection needs looking at later.
setup.saveFailed: That could not be saved. Check the values and try again.
setup.readyBody: Write your first post, or invite a colleague from the Team screen.

account.title: Create the owner account
account.body: The first account owns this installation and can invite everybody else. Registration closes to strangers as soon as it exists.
account.done: An account exists, and new colleagues now arrive by invitation.

facebookApp.title: Add your Facebook app
facebookApp.body: Publishing goes through a Meta app that you own. Create one at developers.facebook.com, then paste its ID and secret here.
facebookApp.hint: While the app is in Development mode, everything works for people who hold a role on it — Admin, Developer or Tester — with no review from Meta. Add your colleagues there and you can skip app review entirely.

connect.title: Connect a Facebook account
connect.body: Sign in with Facebook so this app can see the Pages you manage.

destination.title: Turn on a Page
destination.body: Choose which of your Pages this workspace may publish to. Nothing goes out until at least one is on.
destination.done: At least one destination is ready to publish.

email.title: Set up email
email.body: Without it, a failed post fails silently: nobody is told, and it is found when a client asks why their page went quiet.
email.done: Email is configured, so failures reach somebody.

checks.title: Installation checks
checks.summary: {failing, plural, =0 {all {total} passing} one {# needs attention} other {# need attention}}

sessionSecret.title: Session secret set
sessionSecret.fix: SESSION_SECRET is missing or too short. Run npm run setup, or generate one with openssl rand -base64 48, then restart.

encryptionKey.title: Encryption key valid
encryptionKey.fix: ENCRYPTION_KEY must be exactly 32 bytes, base64-encoded. Run npm run setup, or generate one with openssl rand -base64 32, then restart.

appUrl.title: Public address configured
appUrl.fix: APP_URL still points at localhost. Facebook cannot reach a loopback address, and the OAuth redirect has to match this exactly. Set it to the address people will use, including https://.

database.title: Database reachable
database.fix: The database did not answer. Check DATABASE_URL and that PostgreSQL is running.

mediaDir.title: Media directory writable
mediaDir.fix: Uploads cannot be written. Check MEDIA_DIR exists and that the app's user owns it.

worker.title: Scheduler worker running
worker.fix: No worker has reported in. Nothing will publish until one runs: npm run worker, or systemctl start social-pilot-worker.

targets.noneConnected: No Facebook pages are connected yet.

team.title: Team
team.subtitle: Who can access this client, and what they can do.

roleHints.owner: Full control, including deleting the workspace.

team.acceptBody: You have been invited to join {workspace} as {role}.
team.acceptExpired: This invitation has expired. Ask for a new one.
team.acceptInvalid: This invitation link is not valid.
team.acceptWrongEmail: This invitation was sent to {email}. Sign in with that address to accept it.
